play.title: LoonPop: Balloon Adventure
play.shortDescription: Keep the balloon in the air with a leaf blower – and dodge the needles!
play.fullDescription:
One balloon, one leaf blower and a whole lot of needles.

In LoonPop you keep a balloon in the air with a leaf blower and guide it upwards through rows of needles. The blower always blows straight up. You steer by standing off-centre under the balloon – the edge of the air stream then pushes it sideways. Sounds easy? The balloon has inertia: it reacts with a delay and keeps drifting after you let go. Think ahead and you win.

FIFTEEN HAND-CRAFTED LEVELS
From the first breath of air to the summit: crosswinds, downdrafts, swinging and falling needles, sliding rows of needles, tight zigzag passages and races against the clock. Every level brings something new.

ENDLESS MODE
Up and up, as far as you can go. It keeps getting faster, and again and again narrow passages appear, glowing red. How many metres can you make?

ALSO
• One finger is all you need: slide and hold
• Best times and best distance are saved
• 13 languages
• Plays offline, no internet connection needed
• No account needed
• Remove ads with a one-time purchase
